title.en: Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners’ Protection Schemes (Additional Premium Contribution) Order 2011

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners’ Protection Schemes (Additional Premium Contribution) Order 2011 and shall come into operation on 1st May 2011.

2. For the purposes of section 15(3) of the Act, no DI Scheme member shall, without the prior approval of the Minister, be required to pay additional premium contribution for any premium year exceeding 0.3% of the insured deposit base of that DI Scheme member.
